text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for my debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We've been working hard for this day together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna blast right through the competition with these sculpted hamstrings!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: B-but… do you think I'm gonna be okay? My muscles may be ready, but I can feel my mind fading…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is a debut race… I'm sure everyone is here with their own dreams. Ugh…
Aww, I thought this was gonna happen, Ryan. You're being way too nice.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Everyone has their own reasons for being here, but that doesn't make yours any less important.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Your dream isn't just yours anymore…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Your trainer and I are here with you, giving our support!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right. I have people spotting me no matter what, who want me to succeed.
choice_data_list: Now you've got it! So go out there and flex your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You know, it makes me feel better knowing that my hard work is for others too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've gotta do this—I have to see it through. Just gotta be myself and make my debut!
